dataset: CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database

selection.reason: Forward jump extends the existing single-jump task without introducing a large heading change or a new terrain model.
not_yet_training_ready: Inspect and resolve millimeter-scale ground penetration without framewise re-grounding.
Check initial/final support and dynamic force/torque feasibility.
Define forward-displacement and landing/braking acceptance metrics; do not reuse a high-jump-only threshold as proof of success.
selection.next_candidate_caveat: Large-angle yaw requires reviewing per-landmark fixed-world-offset mapping; low IK target residual does not establish faithful human geometry or angular-momentum feasibility.

clips.retargeting_deferred_reason: A rolling-braking task must map pelvis/heading/height intent instead of copying alternating human foot placement; initial motion and changing endpoint floor residual also need review.

clips.catalog_description: hop turn 90 degrees left in air

limitations: All robot numbers describe solved reference poses, not a policy rollout.
Wheel angles are frozen placeholders during IK, not a rolling-motion prescription.
No force, momentum, contact or rolling constraints are enforced in this IK.
No source clip was retimed or cropped; each subject has its own ASF calibration and retargeting scale.
The human floor and feet-clear diagnostics are keypoint heuristics, not measured contacts or ground-truth takeoff/landing events.
Raw mocap and robot reference arrays remain outside Git; third-party terms remain applicable.
